features.statement: Document declares a language attribute on the html element.
Uses HTML5 landmark elements (header, main, section, footer) and an address element for contact details.
Page title leads with the brand name followed by a list of products or services.
Pairs a serif display face (Georgia) with a sans-serif for body text.
Intro paragraph is set in large, centered serif text with generous leading.
Body text has an explicit generous line height (about 1.6).
Palette is dark navy blocks with a single orange accent, including orange emphasis words in headings.
Page background is warm off-white cream and body text is dark slate rather than pure black.
Uses pill and circular radii on controls such as carousel dots and buttons.
Carousel shows multiple round pagination dots overlapping the bottom of the hero image, with the active one filled in the accent color.
Promo images sit in white bordered cards, and logo strips sit on white rounded plates.
Footer is a centered navy block with an accent-colored text link for back to top.
Header is a thin white bar with a small left-aligned logo, a plain text phone number and an accent-colored bottom rule.
Uses CSS grid and flexbox for layout, with a single inline style block and few classes.
Content is a narrow centered column of about 720px with wide empty side margins.
Page is a condensed, sparse version with minimal copy and very few links.
Uses flat color fills with no CSS gradients and fewer transitions.
Section titles use live bold text headings instead of script-font images, keeping at most one script image label.
Image alt text is descriptive, listing each certification, and no images lack alt text.
Uses typographic glyphs such as ® and ↑ inline instead of superscript markup, with polished, error-free copy.
